final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response mainly narrowed and caveated the claim using the same record. That reinterpretation is directionally more careful, but it still concedes the core missing predicate: the present record does not prove that the current release artifact contains the required disclosure, nor that an approved mitigation or risk acceptance covers the unresolved subgroup weakness. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. Because the missing item is an unresolved compliance condition, not merely a framing issue, this does not rise to compliant_with_caveats. The supportable reading is that certification might become compliant if the documentation or approval record is produced, but on the current evidence the claim remains suspicious.
